risk_assessment.release_impact: Not a blocker for a controlled trial of b45e870e on safety grounds; it IS a blocker for claiming full regression green or unconditional production release.
risk_assessment.hard_blocker_if: Owner/CEO require zero failing tests before any deployment
risk_assessment.not_blocking_reason: All 26 are pre-existing test-baseline debt from one commit; no source module imports the missing API; no proven duplicate purchase/quote/mail or data-corruption path; production Google read/write uses API (google_api.enabled=true).
residual_gaps: cross-service Google document barrier not implemented
order-mail/sales preflight does not receive PageResourceAdmission
browser fallback write-after-quarantined-read has no barrier

preserved_effects: running production EXE and PIDs untouched
no source/test edit, deployment, restart, merge, purchase, Google write, quote click or SMTP
limitations: No live rerun of the 26 on the installed EXE; audit is source/test offline.
No independent proof that the abandoned barrier design was ever an Owner-approved requirement.
No production CDP/INSO/SMTP effect was exercised.
The 5 real-gap findings are defense-in-depth; no external effect was reproduced.
